reading: none of the three convect: the quiet sea nights hold up across the grids
evidence: Three CM1 boxes, one realization each, started from one domain-mean sounding of the sea box's third lunar day with random perturbations and run two Earth days under that hour's forcing held fixed; they differ in grid spacing (6, 3 and 2 km) and the 2 km box in its width (128 km against 192). The source box over the same two days, under its forcing by local time, stands beside them. A numerical test of the grid's effect within CM1 at these settings, with its boundary-layer scheme on at every spacing.
reading_rule: Each grid's days are the 24 hours from its start and the next 24; the source's are days 84.5-85.5 and 85.5-86.5 of its run. Rain in mm/day from CM1's running domain total. Means over the diagnostics after each day's start to its end (half-hourly in the boxes, 3-hourly in the source): CM1's CAPE and inhibition (J/kg, its columns' 0.5 km mixed parcels), the boundary layer's depth (hpbl, m), the strongest updraft (the domain maximum of w below 16 and below 60 km, m/s; a domain of 4,096 columns samples more than one of 1,024), the highest cloud (m, any column holding 0.001 g/kg of cloud water or ice) and the 0.5 km parcel of the domain-mean sounding (box_onset, undiluted and at eps 8). snapshot: means over the 3-D outputs in the day (6-hourly in the boxes, 3-hourly in the source) of box_onset's measures: the 99.9th percentiles of w, the highest cloud top and the shares of columns by cloud top (0.01 g/kg); clouds: the mean and highest top of the cloud below 40 km, the share of columns with cloud at 16-40 km and the share whose cloud above 40 km has none at 16-40 km beneath it. quiet: the control's criteria, set before the runs (control_rule), on the second day; convects: rain of at least reading_rule_limits' 0.5 mm/day with the strongest updraft averaging 5 m/s or cloud tops above 40 km in 5% of the columns. drift: the domain-mean temperature at fixed heights (K) and the mass-weighted temperature (C) and vapour (g/kg) of the GCM's lowest four layers at the start, after a day and at the end; water: box_budget.water over the second day and both, rest closes the vapour and condensate budget (mm/day), and refill_of_empty_air the vapour CM1's microphysics puts back in levels holding no water, where the prescribed table dries air above about 55 km that has none to give, which the rest holds.
